thread:
Ana (PM): quick sync - prototype for invite drawer + audit jump. figma: https://figma.redwood/invite-audit-ux 

Ana (PM): questions: 1) For SSO-only orgs, should email input be removed or disabled with tooltip? 2) For the roles table, can we add a keyboard-friendly 'Jump to activity' control?

Brett (Designer): remove the email input for SSO-only. replace with a tidy panel: 'Invites via SSO' + primary CTA 'Copy join link' + link 'Manage provisioning'. add small ttl hint like 'Link expires: 7 days' (optional).

Brett (Designer): roles: inline pill 'Activity' (button) next to role name. on hover show label; on mobile put it in overflow menu. keep touch target >=44px.

Maya (Frontend): implementation notes: condition on org.flags.sso_enforced. when removing input, announce replacement via aria-live="polite". for activity -> use stable anchor id `audit-role-<id>` and after scroll run:
```
const a = document.getElementById(`audit-role-${id}`);
if (a) { a.setAttribute('tabindex','-1'); a.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'}); a.focus(); }
```
fallback: open audit in new tab if audit pane not loaded.

Li (Backend): backend will return join token via POST /orgs/:id/invite-link -> { token, expires_at|null }. we'll tag audit entries with `anchor_id` so frontend can link directly. no TTL for v1 unless product requests it.

Cass (A11y): checklist:
- announce the invite panel replacement with aria-live and role=region.
- ensure Activity buttons are in logical tab order and include aria-controls to point to audit region.
- anchors must get focus after scroll; remove tabindex when focus leaves.
- check contrast on SSO panel text >=4.5:1.

Ana (PM): action items: Brett -> update comps (desktop + mobile overflow), Maya -> hook up aria-live + focus flow, Li -> API ticket for invite-link, Cass -> final a11y checklist. i'll file tickets and tag owners. thanks! :white_check_mark:
